name: chat-question-card
title: Chat Question Card
description: The agent's questions drawn whole — a pager, a close, the question as the title, full-width options with muted descriptions and no radios, Other, and a Next → / Submit pill — with number keys (QuestionCard), and the line it settles into (QuestionLine).

meta.whenToUse: An agent asking the person to choose between options in a chat.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form a person fills in on a page (Field, RadioGroup); a yes/no permission (ChatRequestCard).
